1. Draft amendment is allowed.
The same shall be carried out at the earliest.
2. Rule returnable forthwith.
Ms. Pathak, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor, waives service of notice of rule for and on behalf of the respondent No.1-State of Gujarat.
Mr. Vahid Shaikh, the learned advocate, has entered appearance on behalf of the respondent No.2-original complainant and waives service of notice of rule.

3. By this application under section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, the petitioners seek to invoke the inherent powers of this court, praying for quashing of the first information report being C.R. No.11187009230023/2023 lodged before the Mahila Police Station,
Mahisagar of the offence punishable under sections 498A, 323, 504, 506(2) read NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/15908/2023 ORDER DATED: 07/04/2025 undefined with section 114 of the Rajendrabhai Kantibhai Parmar vs State Of Gujarat on 7 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33904054/

sentences.text: The respondent No.2-Smt.Hetalben Vinodbhai Makwana is personally present and she confirms about the settlement arrived at with the accused persons.
The respondent No.2- Smt.Hetalben Vinodbhai Makwana is identified by her learned advocate Mr. Vahid Shaikh.

Smt. Hetalben Vinodbhai Makwana has also filed an affidavit, inter alia, stating as under:
"I, undersigned Hetalben Vinodbhai Makvana, female, aged 26 years, Residing at Mahisagar do hereby solemnly affirmed on oath as under:
1. I say and submit that being the complainant.
I'm aware the facts and circumstances of the present case, hence filing present affidavit in support of averments in present application.

2. I submit that I've filed an FIR on 12.11.2023 with Mahila Police Station, Mahisagar being CR no 11187009230023 of 2023 against the applicant for the offenses under sections 498A, 323, 504, 506(2) and 114 of Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 and 7 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. I say that the dispute amongst us came to be resolved amicably and peacefully and the on account of misconception of facts the F.I.R came to be filed for which now no grievance exists against each other.

I say that as in fact F.I.R in question which is filed may not continue in view of resolutions of the dispute amongst us and therefore the prayer as prayed for may kindly be accepted in the facts and circumstances of the present case, under these set of circumstances, if the Hon'ble Court pleased to terminate the proceeding as prayed for NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/15908/2023 ORDER DATED: 07/04/2025 undefined by the petitioner
by quashing and setting aside the F.I.R being CR No.11187009230023 of 2023 filed before Mahila Police Station, Mahisagar as well as further proceedings arising thereof, I've no objection.
4. I'm filing this affidavit on my free will and wish without there being any undue pressure.
Verification
What is stated hereinabove is true to the best of my knowledge, belief and information and I believe the same to be true.

Solemnly affirmed at Balasinor 1 this day 03 of March, 2025."
4.

Taking into consideration the nature of the dispute and the fact that the parties have now amicably decided to live peacefully, no useful purpose would be served to allow the police to continue with the investigation of the said first information report.
